event_identity.present_day_relation: historical municipality now part of Lamezia Terme
event_identity.identity_rationale: The official archival inventory identifies one discrete source-native fascicolo under Sambiase with a bounded January-May 1866 span and a combined description of armed-band complicity and kidnapping. The inventory is sufficient to qualify an individual historical candidate but not to reconstruct the internal chronology of the alleged conduct.

source.series: Miscellanea di Processi Politici e Brigantaggio

location.rule: The archival inventory supports Sambiase as the fascicolo locality but not an address, site or point. No geocoding is authorised from the inventory alone.

classification.rule: Do not force modern ICCS/Istat/legal coding from the short inventory caption before reading the proceeding.

pdf_verification.consequence: Use the official indexed inventory transcription and retain the screenshot failure as a technical limitation; do not claim visual inspection succeeded.

blocker: Retrieve the underlying B.60 fasc.531 proceeding or a more granular archival description before reviewed-bundle compilation.
next_action: Acquire/read B.60 fasc.531; resolve whether the kidnapping and armed-band conduct form one continuing EVENT, multiple occurrence items, or an EVENT plus related conduct.
